entries.reason: the page size of a sparse heap, and this port carries no sparse heap: -newHeapWithDescriptor: refuses one, saying why, because a sparse heap maps its pages in on demand and there is no page mapping to do on a device where a heap is already all of its memory
entries.effect: the page size the application set, read back, and never used, because no heap this port makes is sparse (facts/Metal/Heaps.md)
entries.source: SDK 16.4, Metal (the SDK this package builds against); the behaviour is the one its headers document
